rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from approved organizations listed in IC 25-14-3-2 / IC 25-1-4-0.2 (incl. American Dental Association, Academy of General Dentistry, Board-approved study clubs); other providers need Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt if the initial license was held less than two years (e.g. issued March 2, 2024 to March 1, 2026).
rules.alternatives: Exempt: graduate students/residents in approved programs, Board-found disability; hardship waiver (military, illness). Inactive status needs no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of 1-10% of licensees after each renewal; keep certificates 3 years after the licensing period.

topics.who: Ethics, professional responsibility and Indiana statutes and rules (828 IAC 1-5-6); no exceptions

rules.notes: Half of the hours must be live (interactive webinars count as live; pre-recorded self-study max half). Practice management max 5 h. Permit holders (general anesthesia, deep or light parenteral sedation): 5 h anesthesia CE per period within the 20; BLS not accepted for it.
rules.rule_quote: One renewal cycle is 20 hours of CE with 2 hours of Indiana ethics for Dentists, and 19 hours with 2 hours of Indiana ethics for Dental Hygienists.
